# Captured / source-verified stock-toybox `ping` diagnostic lines and the
# ErrorType each must map to through PingLinux.androidParser. One line per case;
# `#` comments and blank lines are ignored by the loader. Formats verified
# against toybox `toys/net/ping.c` and `lib/net.c` (see android_output_parity_test.dart).
#
# Name-resolution failure. toybox resolves via xgetaddrinfo (lib/net.c), which
# on failure prints `<host>: <gai_strerror(rc)>` — e.g. glibc/bionic
# "Name or service not known" (matched by the shared `service not known`
# alternative). The `bad address` phrasing recorded in Batch 1 is also pinned so
# either wording a given toybox build emits maps to unknownHost.
unknownHost | invalid.example: Name or service not known
unknownHost | google.invalid: bad address
#
# Kernel ICMP errors surfaced via `perror_exit("recvmsg")` -> `ping: recvmsg: <strerror(errno)>`.
noRoute | ping: recvmsg: Network is unreachable
noRoute | ping: recvmsg: No route to host
#
# TTL/hop-limit expiry. Stock toybox emits NO dedicated line for this (an
# intermediate hop's ICMP Time Exceeded is delivered as a kernel errno and shows
# up as a recvmsg no-route above). androidParser retains the iputils-format
# `timeToLiveRgx` so any build that DOES print such a line still maps it; this
# line pins that retained path.
timeToLiveExceeded | From 192.168.1.1 icmp_seq=1 Time to live exceeded
